title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 26 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 26 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers will occur at a few places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
